sources.title: County of Lehigh Election Night Results, 2026 Primary, labeled 'Official Election Results' (website updated 6/8/2026); lists only contests with filed candidates
Lehigh County Summary Results Report by precinct, General Primary May 19, 2026 (labeled UNOFFICIAL, generated 06/02/2026), used for contests without filed candidates and write-in totals
Lehigh County Voter Registration: Election Results index
Official results export, used for holder names (results.pdf)

notes: Each of 158 precincts has one 'REP Member of the County Committee' contest (157 vote for 2, 1 vote for 1); seats are labeled 'Member'. Filed-candidate vote counts in the precinct PDF (marked unofficial, 06/02/2026) match the county's official results site (6/8/2026) in all 56 contests with filed candidates; empty and write-in-only seats come from the unofficial PDF, because the official site omits write-ins and contests without filed candidates. Status rules: filed candidate inside the top N with votes = filled (unknown on a boundary tie or if write-ins exceeded a lone candidate); open seats are unknown when any write-in votes were cast (the PDF mostly reports them as 'Scattered') and empty when none were. Appointments after the primary are not reflected. Holder names come from the official results export: on each seat already counted as filled, the winning ballot candidate as printed (named write-ins are never used).
